title: In-memory limiter maps: one expiry rule and a size bound
evidence: (a) rate-limiter.ts isLive (now < expiresAt) is the one rule: createRateLimiter, createQuotaCounter, sweepExpired and the subscription summary cache all read it; the limiters had counted the expiry instant itself. (b) boundedMap: each map holds a bounded number of entries (MAX_TRACKED_KEYS for the 36 limiter maps, SUMMARY_CACHE_MAX_KEYS for the cache); when full, the oldest entry makes room. The factory's whenFull option names the policy; the spent-challenge set is the one map that keeps every entry (US-52 AC1a). A full map is reported once an hour by name. (c) sweepExpired returns its timer; the gateway pin finds it by the cache map
durability_check: app/lib/ttl-bound.test.ts (US-52 AC4f, US-59 AC12: bounds, policy per call site, the warning), app/lib/ttl-sweep.test.ts (US-52 AC4f: expiry instant; the gateway timer by map), route tests in app-routes.server.test.ts, api.measurements.bounded-map.test.ts, api.lab-import-v2.bounded-map.test.ts
